_readme: Jersey of the Day. One entry per day, keyed by US Eastern date (YYYY-MM-DD). To add a day, copy an entry, change the key and fill every field. Images must already be on the site (public/images/...) or verified PD/CC Commons images with credit, never Getty/AP/fan/retailer. Run node scripts/compress-images.mjs after adding a new image. 'why' is Jake's line; whyPlaceholder true means it is a draft awaiting his OK (the page renders it like any other line). Optional '_editorNote' is internal only, never rendered. worn.status: Confirmed (team or game photos), Announced (team schedule), Scheduled (team date list), Expected (league or team default, not announced), Projected (our read, not a team call). Optional shop fields (lib/affiliates.ts): shopUrl = a fanatics.com product URL for the Get this jersey at Fanatics link (else it searches Fanatics for team + jerseyName), shopQuery = custom Fanatics search words, shop false = no link that day.

2026-10-25.imageAlt: Seattle Seahawks royal blue throwback jersey with green and white stripes

worn.matchup: vs Kansas City Chiefs, Sunday Night Football, Week 7

2026-10-25.why: Royal blue and silver under the lights on Sunday night. It's the best look Seattle has, and it's not close.
2026-10-25.story: Seattle's royal blue throwback goes with the silver helmet and silver pants. The Seahawks wore it at Denver on Thursday night in Week 6 and bring it home for Sunday Night Football against Kansas City, one of the three primetime jersey games on their 2026 schedule.

2026-10-26.imageAlt: Indiana Pacers players in the blue 2026-27 Classic Threads ABA Classic Edition uniform with an arched INDIANA and yellow block numbers

tweet.label: On the court: the Classic Threads debut at Brooklyn, a 136-109 win

2026-10-26.why: Royal blue, an arched INDIANA and that yellow racing stripe over the shoulder. It's the best throwback in the NBA this year.
2026-10-26.story: Classic Threads recreates the blue road uniform the Pacers wore in the ABA from 1971 to 1974: royal blue, a white arched INDIANA, yellow block numbers and a yellow and white racing stripe that runs over one shoulder and down the side. The team says it won two of its three ABA championships in this look. It is one of four ABA Classic Editions marking the 50th anniversary of the ABA-NBA merger, and Indiana has it on the schedule for 15 games.

related.label: All four ABA Classic Editions, graded

2026-10-27.imageAlt: Anaheim Ducks orange home sweater with the duck-mask crest, black, white and gold stripes at the waist and sleeves, black cuffs and the webbed-foot D on the shoulders

worn.note: League default: the dark sweater at home. Anaheim has no third jersey this season.

2026-10-27.why: Nobody else in the NHL wears orange this bright at home, and the duck mask on it looks like it belongs in the '90s in the best way.
2026-10-27.story: Orange became the Ducks' primary color in the 2024 rebrand, which also brought back the duck-mask crest from the Mighty Ducks years in a refreshed form. The home sweater has that crest, black, white and gold stripes at the waist, chevron sleeve stripes that run into a black cuff and the old webbed-foot D on the shoulders, unchanged for 2026-27. Anaheim said there would be no alternate when the orange set launched, so this is the sweater for every home game, including tonight against Vancouver at Honda Center.

related.label: NHL uniform tracker: every game, every sweater

2026-10-28.imageAlt: Los Angeles Lakers gold Icon Edition jersey with purple LAKERS wordmark and numbers

worn.note: Confirmed from the game: the Lakers wore the gold Icon against the Clippers' navy Icon and won 103-87.

2026-10-28.why: Forum gold is the most famous color in basketball, and tonight it goes across town against Clippers blue in the LA rivalry.
2026-10-28.story: The gold Icon Edition is the Lakers' most-worn jersey of 2026-27, scheduled for 28 of 80 dated games, and 19 of those come on the road. Tonight is one of them: the second Lakers-Clippers game in six days, this time at Intuit Dome, with the Clippers in their blue Icon. The Lakers won the first meeting 125-117 at Crypto.com Arena on October 23 in purple.

related.label: NBA uniform tracker: every game, every jersey

2026-10-29.imageAlt: Green Bay Packers Vintage Green home jersey, dark green with gold and white sleeve stripes and white numbers

worn.matchup: vs Carolina Panthers, Thursday Night Football, Week 8
worn.note: Green Bay has not published a game-by-game schedule; this is the standard home call. We confirm at kickoff.

2026-10-29.why: Dark green, gold pants, gold helmet. They've barely changed it in decades because there's nothing to fix.
2026-10-29.story: Green Bay calls it Vintage Green, one of the four uniforms in the club's 2026 lineup alongside 1923, Classic White and Rivalries. The green jersey with gold pants is one of the least-changed uniforms in American sport, and it carries most of the home schedule, including Atlanta on a Thursday in Week 3, Dallas in Week 6 and Carolina on a Thursday night in Week 8.

2026-10-30.imageAlt: Philadelphia 76ers red Statement Edition jersey with white Phila script and blue side panels with white stars

worn.matchup: vs New York Knicks, Prime Video
worn.note: On the 76ers' published schedule: red Statement at home, Knicks in white.

2026-10-30.why: Red Phila script, blue star panels down the side and the Knicks in white on national TV. It's the 76ers' first red night of the season.
2026-10-30.story: The 76ers have opened 2026-27 in their blue Icon and white Association jerseys. Friday is the first scheduled night for the red Statement Edition: white Phila script, white numbers trimmed in blue, and blue side panels with white stars. The Knicks wear white, and it is the second Sixers-Knicks game of the season after Philadelphia won 106-100 at Madison Square Garden on opening night.

2026-10-31.imageAlt: Oklahoma State all-orange Halloween uniform: orange helmet with the OSU logo, orange OKLAHOMA STATE jersey and orange pants on hay bales under a Happy Halloween banner, with black skeleton-print Nike cleats

tweet.label: The reveal: "THE uniform matchup of the weekend"

worn.matchup: at Iowa State, 7 p.m. ET on FOX
worn.note: Oklahoma State posted the all-orange look for Halloween; Iowa State answers in all black.

2026-10-31.why: Orange helmet, orange jersey, orange pants and skeleton cleats on Halloween night, against Iowa State in all black. It was No. 2 in our Halloween ranking.
2026-10-31.story: Oklahoma State revealed the look as "THE uniform matchup of the weekend": an orange helmet, orange jersey and orange pants, staged on hay bales with black Nike cleats printed with white skeleton bones and an orange swoosh. Iowa State answered with its own "halloween threads," a black helmet with a white Cynado, black jersey and black pants, so it is orange against black on Halloween night in Ames.

related.label: Every College Football Week 9 Halloween uniform

2026-11-01.imageAlt: Washington Capitals player in the red Screaming Eagle third jersey with a white shoulder yoke and the Capitol Dome shoulder patch, February 2026
2026-11-01.imageCaption: The red Screaming Eagle on February 25, 2026, against the Flyers.
2026-11-01.why: The diving eagle across a red chest is the best third jersey in hockey, and I'm glad they're bringing it out 10 times.
2026-11-01.story: The red Screaming Eagle has the diving eagle across the chest, a white rounded shoulder yoke, 1970s hem striping, a lace-up collar and the 1990s Capitol Dome patch on the shoulders. It went 15 times in its first season, 2025-26, and Washington has it down for 10 home games this season. Tonight against the Wild is the third of them.

2026-11-04.imageAlt: Tage Thompson in the Buffalo Sabres Hometown Remix jersey: royal blue with the throwback goat head crest, white and gold stripes, captain A

worn.matchup: vs Ottawa Senators, Hometown Remix debut

2026-11-04.why: Royal blue with the goat head big in the middle of the chest. Buffalo just does uniforms well.
2026-11-04.story: The Sabres debut their Hometown Remix jersey tonight at home against Ottawa: royal blue with the throwback goat head crest front and center, plus white and gold stripes on the arms and hem. We ranked it fourth of all 32 Remix jerseys. Buffalo wears it eight times this season, seven of them at home.

2026-11-05.imageAlt: Baltimore Ravens player in the Purple Rising uniform: metallic purple helmet with gold stripes and a gold facemask, purple jersey with red and gold numbers, purple pants

worn.matchup: vs Jacksonville Jaguars, Thursday Night Football
worn.note: Worn as announced, confirmed from game photos. Jaguars won 33-10.

2026-11-05.why: Purple from the helmet to the socks, with a gold facemask. Nobody else in the league can pull off one color head to toe like this.
2026-11-05.story: The Ravens go all purple tonight against the Jaguars on Thursday Night Football: the metallic purple Purple Rising helmet with gold stripes and a gold facemask, the purple jersey and purple pants. It is the third time Baltimore has worn the look and the first in the new Next Flight version. Jacksonville wears white with black helmets.

related.label: Purple Rising vs. Jaguars: every detail

2026-11-06.imageAlt: Arizona Wildcats Sandstorm uniform: red chrome helmet with ARIZONA across the side, white jersey with red numbers and a red collar

worn.matchup: vs TCU, Friday night in Tucson
worn.note: Arizona's first official Sandstorm-themed game; fans are asked to wear white. Photo from the October 10 game at West Virginia, when the set was worn with red pants.

2026-11-06.why: A red chrome helmet over a white jersey with red numbers, at a home game where the whole stadium wears white. It is the best look in Arizona's closet.
2026-11-06.story: Arizona hosts TCU tonight in its first official Sandstorm game: a chrome red helmet with ARIZONA across the side, the white jersey with red numbers, white pants and red socks, with fans asked to wear white. The Wildcats wore Sandstorm with red pants in a 52-31 win at West Virginia on October 10. Tonight it goes back to white pants, the way the set debuted against Oklahoma State in 2025.

2026-11-07.imageAlt: Oregon Mummy Mode 2.0 uniform: dark chrome helmet, white jersey with a black chrome number 9, black pants and glossy black cleats

worn.matchup: at No. 2 Ohio State, 3:30 p.m. ET on CBS
worn.note: Worn as posted, confirmed from the game broadcast. Final: Oregon 41, Ohio State 28.

2026-11-07.why: A dark chrome helmet and black pants around a white jersey, worn in the Horseshoe in the biggest game of the day. Oregon saved its sharpest look for Ohio State.
2026-11-07.story: Oregon went to No. 2 Ohio State in Mummy Mode 2.0 and won 41-28. The look: a dark chrome helmet with a chrome facemask, a white jersey with black chrome numbers and a charcoal and silver feather pattern on the shoulders, and black pants. It replaced the yellow helmet and green jersey Oregon showed in its game-week graphic on Monday. Ohio State wore scarlet jerseys with scarlet pants instead of its usual gray.

2026-11-08.imageAlt: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback throwing in the Kelly Green uniform: kelly green helmet with silver wings and a kelly green jersey with white numbers

worn.matchup: vs. Giants, 1:00 p.m. ET on FOX
worn.note: Worn as announced, confirmed from the team's game photos. Final: Giants 19, Eagles 11.

2026-11-08.why: Kelly green with silver wings is the best throwback in the NFL, and it looked even better against the Giants in their own white throwbacks.
2026-11-08.story: The Eagles wore Kelly Green against the Giants at Lincoln Financial Field: a kelly green helmet with silver wings, a kelly green jersey with white numbers, silver pants with a green-white-green stripe and kelly green gloves. The Giants wore Vintage White, so both teams were in throwbacks. New York won 19-11.

related.label: Giants Vintage White vs. Eagles Kelly Green
